arithmetic.causal: 5*3canonical-primary*16base-test episodes*8final slots=1920; each instantiated slot contains baseline and targeted/random/substitution branch results for8steps
arithmetic.lineage: 5*3primary*2orders*32train episodes=960, plus5*3primary*2orders=30 control-construction rows. Each construction row contains the two bank kinds random/frequency for ONE order, hence60 control banks. It does not contain two order banks.

artifacts.dynamic_bounds: At most30 primary banks*32 lifetime births +60 reference banks*8 static references =1440 candidate/reference records nested in the90 bank rows. Verify exact dynamic counts/IDs against lineage births and tombstones, not a fixed fictitious row count.
artifacts.failure_examples_selection: One audit record per successful run_seed/representation/world: select base-test episode with maximum primary_MSE-min(random_MSE,frequency_MSE), tie episode_id. Retain even when regret<=0 with classification=no_failure_observed. Include CC0 transitive-pair/diameter, proliferation/collapse and null-denominator audit fields; do not omit inconvenient counterexamples. winner_share_max=max non-null winner count divided by total matched steps in the selected episode, null if no matched steps. List transitive member-feature pairs with zero joint base-train occurrence; minimum_retained_pair_cosine is null for fewer than two nonzero retained exemplars.
artifacts.row_design: Episode-level raw records contain exact9 sensory/discovery frames or exact8 next-step prediction rows; this avoids repeating full state as tens of thousands of top-level lines. Dynamic birth/event arrays remain explicit, bounded and reconstructible, never padded with invented candidates.

canonicalization.H: sha256(UTF8(text)).hexdigest(); opaque IDs use the first 24 hex characters
canonicalization.float_equality: Exact stored values for reconstruction; gates use the written inclusive/strict operators without added epsilon; cosine clamped to [-1,1] only to remove floating dot-product overshoot
canonicalization.floating_point: Python/NumPy float64 throughout formation, scoring, ridge and statistics; learned encoder CPU torch.float64, one thread, deterministic algorithms; no rounded intermediate or artifact values
canonicalization.json: json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8'); artifact JSON adds exactly one LF; JSONL uses one such object plus LF per row; empty JSONL is zero bytes
canonicalization.unknown_keys: Reject recursively; each object follows an exact named schema below. No extra debug fields, timestamps, local paths, or exception messages in scientific artifacts.
canonicalization.zero_norm: norm <= 1e-12 means a vector has no cosine match; cosine is null, not zero or one; no candidate birth from such a representation

causal_interventions.absent_slot: One explicit row with candidate_id=null,status=not_instantiated; all branch predictions and metrics null, no observed-zero substitution. Do not count absent slots as intervention opportunities.
causal_interventions.matched_random_suppression: Temporarily exclude the preselected r instead of c, then rerun matching and ridge. If comparator absent, predictions/losses are null and branch status=no_comparator.
causal_interventions.restore: Clear the temporary exclusion/substitution view, query every step again, and require winner ID, no-match reason, raw/clipped prediction bytes, bank state hash, AE hash and ridge hash equal baseline. Record before/after/restore hashes and restored prediction hash. A mismatch is engineering failure, not a negative concept result.
causal_interventions.scope: Canonical primary banks only, all16 base-test episodes, all8 final slot indices. No concept/AE/readout updates and no refitting. All branches consume identical cached sensory emissions and targets.
causal_interventions.substitution: Start from base winner; whenever it is c replace its one-hot slot by preselected r without changing inputs, representation, thresholds or weights; otherwise keep base one-hot. If comparator absent, branch is no_comparator. This is explicitly a forced representation substitution diagnostic, not normal matching.
causal_interventions.targeted_suppression: Temporarily exclude c from matching eligibility and rerun the unchanged top1 selector; a below-threshold replacement cannot be forced. Query the same frozen ridge.
causal_interventions.usage_matching: u(c)=number of frozen-bank base-train top1 wins at t<8, integer0..256. Comparator candidates are different nondeleted slots r with abs(u(r)-u(c))<=max(2,.25*u(c)). Among them choose smallest(H('c16|suppression-control|'+str(run_seed)+'|'+representation+'|'+candidate_id+'|'+other_id),other_id). Freeze once from train; no test labels, effects or test usage in selection. No eligible comparator means comparator_id=null and CC3 cannot pass.

engineering_tests_before_official_pin: Pure fixture hashes independently reconstructed for all15 run_seed/split combinations; no model/controller execution on official seeds

Protocol tests cover both amended and unamended states and run safely without Git. Reconstruct an explicit synthetic base fixture; never treat the mutable current canonical amended protocol as its own unchanged base. Run this suite both before source commit and after the pin amendment before any official evaluation.
Reserved synthetic recurrence across episodes versus same-episode duplicate; no CC0 below3episodes2contexts
C12 actual emitted mask/quiet-vector handling; no guessed12-spark guarantee
CC0 source hash preservation and explicit unsupported lifecycle no-ops
Prototype update/merge/split thresholds, full-union complete-link bridge rejection, every tie and budget boundary
Retained observable-exemplar limit,288-ID registry bound, identical-ID exact no-op including CC0, changed-ID-content rejection before mutation, lineage acyclicity and stable feature IDs
Random/frequency pattern ranking, count shortfall and zero-mean learned reference handling without outcome labels
Exact20 AE optimizer steps and shared checkpoint; train-only deterministic ridge including empty bank/intercept-only behavior
No test inputs/IDs in fitting; evaluator relabel and future-prefix invariance
CC1 Jaccard zero union; CC2 exact common candidate-active subset and min8 boundary
Comparator train-only usage tolerance, no comparator fail-closed, target/random/substitution with exact state/prediction restore
Grade stages and same-world3seed replication without cross-seed identity alignment
Complete failed-seed buffering, common lists, S=0 exact8/zero-byte JSONL, partial counts/null intervals
Real spawned synthetic timeout, terminate/kill/quarantine, no late publication and nonempty-output preservation
Two-process reserved synthetic artifact generation with different PYTHONHASHSEED and byte equality; external unique temporary paths only

failure_and_resource_contract.S_zero: Publish the exact8 files. All three JSONL files are zero bytes; JSON dynamic arrays are empty, static configurations remain in protocol, common failure list remains in runtime JSON, every stage's unavailable numerical count is null and status not_evaluated_implementation_failure. report names all failed seeds and no result is fabricated.
failure_and_resource_contract.aggregate_scaling: If S>0 retain72 utility aggregate rows and48 control aggregate comparisons, computed descriptively from complete successful seeds. If S=0 these arrays are empty. Every partial-run interval effect/lower/upper/defined_resamples/undefined_resamples is null, resamples10000 and bootstrap_seed4366 retained; no bootstrap execution. Aggregate raw sums/counts remain descriptive when S>0 and are never scientific support.
failure_and_resource_contract.atomic_output: All preflight before staging creation; staging is a fresh sibling of output; refuse nonempty output without modifying it. Publish only exact8 validated files by atomic directory rename after successful worker termination. No checkpoints, traces or ninth manifest file outside the exact inventory within the published artifact directory.
failure_and_resource_contract.atomic_unit: One run_seed across every representation, discovery order, control, readout and dev/test/causal row. Buffer until all seed-local phases and validation succeed; discard the entire buffer on first failure, record one failure row, never retry that seed, continue with the next registered seed.
failure_and_resource_contract.failure_identity: representation/discovery_order/bank_kind are the current frozen enum or null when not yet applicable. error_hash=sha256(canonical [phase,representation,discovery_order,bank_kind,error_type]); no exception text/path in artifacts. All JSON files repeat the same failed_seeds list sorted by run_seed; protocol carries the protocol contract, not runtime failure fields.
failure_and_resource_contract.global_failures: Aggregation/serialization/integrity errors outside a seed or global timeout abort the whole staged bundle, never manufacture a failed seed. Record the global failure in the parent ledger, not as a successful eight-file scientific artifact.
failure_and_resource_contract.scientific_failure: Any failed required seed fixes engineering_status=implementation_failure and scientific stage status=not_evaluated_implementation_failure. Retain successful raw/lineage/descriptive metrics; do not infer missing seeds, promote CC1+ candidates, or count absent slots as successes.
failure_and_resource_contract.timeout_boundary: Parent preflight excluded; monotonic deadline begins immediately before spawning one worker. Worker performs all generation, training, evaluation, aggregation, validation and staging writes. Parent must confirm worker exit by deadline and alone publishes. No deadline extension after partial progress.
failure_and_resource_contract.timeout_error: C16RunTimeoutError, CLI exit124; other global errors exit1; completed failed-seed bundle exit2; complete engineering-pass bundle exit0 even when scientific result is negative. No elapsed-time value enters deterministic artifacts.
failure_and_resource_contract.timeout_termination: Terminate/join5s, then kill/join5s if alive. Late normal exit never permits publication. Clean staging only after child termination is confirmed; otherwise quarantine and report absolute path on stderr. New final stays absent; pre-existing empty final stays empty.

formation.birth: An unmatched nonzero representation immediately births one candidate if live count<8 and births<32: prototype=z, usage0, first_seen=last_seen=current frame, one retained exemplar, parents empty. Otherwise birth_rejected with capacity or birth_budget, no automatic overwrite. The new candidate is this observation's returned winner; grade remains null until evaluator recurrence qualifies. Zero-norm vectors produce no-match and no birth. No pending pool, observation-grouping algorithm or extra birth minimum.
formation.budget_atomicity: Check operation capacity and every consumed birth ID before retiring or mutating parents. Failed structural operations only append an audit rejection; no partial membership/usage/prototype change.
formation.candidate_id: 'ca-'+H('c16|'+bank_kind+'|'+representation+'|'+str(run_seed)+'|'+discovery_order+'|'+str(birth_ordinal))[0:24]; increasing birth ordinal never reused. CC0 wrapper maps immutable internal source IDs to these external IDs on first discovery, assigning simultaneous births in source-ID order; it never edits the source IDs or source state logic. No evaluator field or human category enters candidate IDs.
formation.cc0_unsupported_operations: merge,split,dormancy,deletion and prototype homeostasis are unsupported no-ops for immutable CC0. The wrapper applies bounded observation deduplication BEFORE source.observe(active_features,time=global_frame_index). Source updates/births remain observable; source maximum_concepts8 implies lifetime births<=8. Record unsupported capabilities instead of inventing lifecycle events.
formation.deletion: Before matching, retire candidates with global_frame_index-last_seen>=32. Keep tombstone, last prototype, feature members, recurrence counters and lineage; deleted IDs cannot be reused.
formation.dormancy: Before the current match, mark dormant if global_frame_index-last_seen>=16. A current match awakens it. No dormancy event is emitted twice without intervening awakening.
formation.identity_registry: A bounded map observation_id->canonical_vector_sha256. At most288 distinct train observations per bank. Repeated ID with identical digest returns duplicate_ignored with no winner/event and exact state equality: no clock, recurrence, retained exemplars, weights, usage, source CC0 count, or lineage-state update. Changed vector under an existing ID fails closed. A289th distinct ID fails before any state mutation. Frozen inference uses query(vector), never observe, and never grows this registry.
formation.initial_membership_rule: Bank birth need not imply cross-context recurrence. Every primary candidate remains unqualified with grade=null until the evaluator observes>=3 unique episodes and>=2 contexts; no evaluator metadata is introduced to force qualification.
formation.match: Nonzero cosine >=0.8; choose eligible prototype with largest cosine-0.05*usage, tie lexicographic candidate_id. Source CC0 uses its own overlap eligibility/selection and is not given a prototype score.
formation.member_features: Sorted union of nonzero emitted stable feature IDs across a candidate's retained exemplars. Assembly candidates preserve source members instead. Exemplar identities, feature identities and lineage parent-candidate identities remain separate fields.
formation.merge: After split, among untouched frame-start surviving candidate pairs require prototype cosine>=.95 AND every distinct pair in the combined retained exemplar union has cosine>=.8. Choose highest prototype cosine, tie sorted candidate-ID pair. Require remaining birth budget>=1. Retire both parents and birth one normalized-mean child; retain latest32 union exemplars; usage=min(1,parent_usage_sum), first_seen=current frame, last_seen=max retained observation frame. Check complete-link on the full union before truncating. At most one merge per frame; newly born or split candidates cannot be merged that frame.
formation.observable_exemplar: Exact {observation_id,global_frame_index,feature_ids,emitted_vector,representation}; observation_id='ob-'+H(sample_id)[0:24]. global_frame_index is the bank's accepted-unique-observation counter; feature_ids are derived from nonzero coordinates in its fixed channel map. No episode/context metadata enters this record.
formation.observe_api: observe(emitted_vector,observation_id) only. Validate exactly12 finite non-bool real values in[0,1] and a nonblank opaque string ID before all mutation. Canonicalize values to float64, hash canonical vector bytes, then apply bounded identity handling before clock/usage/source.observe.
operation_order: validate vector and bounded observation identity before any mutation
assign global_frame_index=current accepted count then increment count
update all usage and matched prototype/awakening
if unmatched nonzero attempt one immediate birth
formation.retention: Retain at most the latest32 assigned distinct observation IDs per candidate, sorting by(global_frame_index,observation_id). window_frames names this bounded retained-observation window, not an additional pending pool. Repeated identity with changed content fails closed. Retired candidate snapshots remain bounded by32 lifetime births.
formation.returned_winner: The observation winner is the pre-structural matched or immediately born candidate. Preserve that ID in the returned observation and lineage even if the subsequent split/merge retires it in this same frame. Never transfer the current win to new children or a merged replacement. CC0 qualification is reconstructed from these actual discovery winners only; retired candidates keep their already observed recurrence counts.
formation.split: After update/birth, among frame-start surviving candidates not already operated choose largest dispersion D=mean(sum_j((z_j-p_j)^2)) over retained normalized exemplars, tie candidate ID. D must be strictly>.2. Pivots are the pair with maximal squared L2 distance, tie sorted observation-ID pair. Assign each record to the nearer pivot by squared L2, tie smaller pivot observation ID. Require each child>=4 exemplars and nonzero normalized mean. Require replacement total count<=8 and remaining birth budget>=2; otherwise split_rejected without partial state mutation. Retire parent and create two children in pivot-ID order, with usage=parent_usage*child_count/parent_count, first_seen=current frame, last_seen=max retained observation frame. Evaluator recurrence is never read or inherited by this operation.
formation.update: For matched prototype p, set p=normalize(.9*p+.1*z). If updated norm<=1e-12 fail closed. Append the distinct observation, update last_seen, and awaken if dormant. No repeated observation creates new independent recurrence.
formation.usage: For prototype discovery each existing candidate usage=.95*old+.05*I(winner); usage starts0, and is frozen in evaluation. Dormant candidates remain eligible to match and awaken; dormancy is an inactivity status, not a forced no-match.

grading.cc0: At least3 distinct train episodes and2 evaluator contexts in which the live discovery trace actually returned this candidate as top1 winner. Use the externally recorded observation-ID to episode/context mapping; do not inherit parent qualifications after merge/split or count prior records retroactively as child wins. Recurrence counts are independent episode/context counts, never delivery count or source reuse_count. Otherwise grade=null with insufficient_independent_recurrence, including CC0-source assemblies.
grading.cc1: CC0 and a nondeleted canonical primary candidate; candidate wins in>=2 distinct base-test episodes and>=2 evaluator contexts. For amplitude_perturbation and irrelevant_distractor separately, compare that candidate's binary winner activation over the same128 test step indices to base: Jaccard=both-active/either-active, require>=.8 for BOTH. Empty union gives null and fails.
grading.cc2: CC1. Freeze subset A_c={(episode,t): canonical primary base-test winner is c,t<8}; require>=8 steps. On those exact same indices, primary prediction is the candidate's one-hot contribution plus intercept; compare its mean12-channel squared error with each matched_random and frequency_topk bank's ordinary predictions. Both(control_MSE-primary_MSE)>=.01. Do not replace this with whole-bank utility or select the subset using correctness/target value.
grading.cc3_local: CC2; a valid train-selected usage-matched random slot exists; on all32 base-test prediction steps in target_world require MSE(targeted suppression)-MSE(base)>=.05 and targeted impairment minus matched-random impairment>=.03. On the96 steps in the other three worlds require MSE(targeted suppression)-MSE(base)<=.02. No clipping of negative impairment/collateral. Exact restore invariants must pass. Substitution effect is reported, not an additional gate.
grading.cc3_replication: For each representation and train_target_world, count distinct complete run_seeds having at least one canonical candidate passing cc3_local for that world. Need>=3 of the five required seeds. A locally passing candidate receives CC3 only if its representation/world replication count passes. This is recurrence of a functional effect, not correspondence of candidate IDs or discovery of one identical concept across seeds.
grading.incomplete_control_matching: If either required matched control bank has shortfall>0, CC2 and CC3 are unavailable for every candidate in that primary bank. Retain qualified CC0 or CC1, qualification=control_matching_incomplete, and descriptive numerical gains if computable; do not assert a matched-control benefit. Below-CC0 candidates remain grade=null. This is a scientific qualification limit, not a reason to invent reference prototypes.
grading.reference_prototypes: Every reference has grade=null and qualification reference_control_not_discovered. It is not a candidate to which a discovered-concept claim is assigned.
grading.retired_and_order_controls: Every born primary candidate remains in candidate_metrics. Retired and episode_shuffle candidates may receive CC0 if qualified, otherwise null; no CC1+ promotion because their full held-out perturbation/causal panel is absent. Keep qualification explaining this scope.
grading.status: All engineering invariants can pass with no graded concepts. Per-stage scientific support is supported when at least one eligible canonical primary candidate meets that stage's complete registered criteria, otherwise not_supported. Report representation/world scope and candidate count; never select the best seed and hide the others. Any failed required run_seed disables CC1+ promotion and all cross-seed scientific support, with not_evaluated_implementation_failure.
grading.train_target_world: After fitting, count the candidate's frozen-bank top1 wins on train t<8 grouped by evaluator world. Choose largest count, tie world_order; zero total means target_world=null and CC3 cannot pass. Evaluator labels do not reenter discovery or prediction.

leakage_boundary.episode_identity_use: Episode IDs, contexts, sample IDs and emission metadata are held outside the bank. The bank receives only a numeric twelve-vector and opaque observation_id. Evaluator maps IDs back to independent episodes/contexts for grades; this mapping cannot affect birth, matching or updates.
leakage_boundary.evaluator_only: world/context/phase, next-frame targets, grades and cross-seed recurrence results are held in a separate evaluator namespace. Train-majority-world targeting is computed only after formation and ridge fitting and cannot feed back into them.
leakage_boundary.learning_data: Only base train observations from the current run_seed. No dev/test vector, identifier, activation, target, prototype, frequency count, normalization statistic, checkpoint score or calibration statistic may affect AE, bank formation, controls, readout or comparator selection.
required_probes: Changing evaluator world/context names leaves discovery state and predictions byte-identical
Permuting next-frame targets leaves AE and bank bytes unchanged, although readout fitting and utility may change
Changing any dev/test fixture leaves all learned/formation/control/readout/comparator bytes unchanged
Repeated same observation identity never increases independent-episode recurrence
Future suffix changes do not change prior sensory outputs

matched_controls.construction_time: After each primary bank is frozen; exactly one construction row per run_seed/representation/discovery_order contains both control banks. No dev/test data or outcome target is read.
matched_controls.frequency_topk_generator: Sort groups by(-frame_count,pattern_id); choose the first reference_count. This is top-K frequent multichannel masks, not a deliberately collapsed list of repeated single-feature prototypes.
matched_controls.matching_budget: Same coordinate representation, maximum8 slots, top1, eligibility threshold, fixed one-hot plus intercept ridge, and training/held-out examples as the primary. Membership size and actual activation frequency need not match exactly; retain both as matching diagnostics rather than claiming they match.
matched_controls.maximum_count: m=number of nondeleted primary candidates including dormant ones, m<=8. Reference count=min(m,number of distinct nonempty emitted-feature masks in base train). Remaining one-hot slots are zero; report any count shortfall, never synthesize extra observed patterns.
matched_controls.pattern_groups: Group the288 base train emitted vectors by exact sorted nonzero emitted feature-ID mask. Exclude empty masks. pattern_id='pa-'+H(canonical_json(mask).decode('utf-8'))[0:24]. Store frame_count and distinct_episode_count; no next-frame target in these counts.
matched_controls.random_generator: Sort distinct pattern groups by(H('c16|random|'+str(run_seed)+'|'+representation+'|'+discovery_order+'|'+pattern_id),pattern_id); choose the first reference_count. This is a seeded hash ranking, not best-of-many random search.
matched_controls.reference_ids: 'rf-'+H('c16|'+bank_kind+'|'+representation+'|'+str(run_seed)+'|'+discovery_order+'|'+str(birth_ordinal))[0:24], birth ordinal is selected-pattern rank starting0; pattern_id is stored separately, and reference prototypes are not claimed to be discovered candidates
matched_controls.reference_per_representation: cc0_assembly references use each selected group's exact stable feature mask and the source overlap eligibility threshold. online/learned references use normalize(mean of the fixed matching representations of that group's base train frames)); groups whose mean norm<=1e-12 are ineligible and scanning continues down the same frozen ranking. If fewer eligible groups remain, retain the shortfall. Never refit the learned representation.
matched_controls.slot_order: Sort the final primary or reference candidate IDs lexicographically into slots0..m-1; pad remaining indices to7 with absent slots. The final slot mapping is immutable during readout fitting and all evaluation.
matched_controls.unsupported_operations: Reference banks are static controls: update,merge,split,dormancy,deletion are explicitly unsupported no-ops; construction records reference_birth only, no discovery recurrence claim. Reference grade is null with qualification reference_control_not_discovered.
matched_controls.usage: For prototype references, compute frozen usage on one canonical base-train replay using raw cosine winner with candidate-ID ties and the .95/.05 update; no prototype updates. Queries subsequently use cosine-.05*frozen_usage. CC0 references use overlap score without usage penalty, matching CC0 primary.

perceptual_lineage.identity: Separate episode/variant registration graphs avoid treating two corrupted versions of one sample ID as one mutable observation. The bank observes only base train once per discovery order.
perceptual_lineage.minimality: Do not create semantic EvidenceRecord support/contradiction claims for concept discovery. Sample/Spark registration and exact parent resolution suffice; candidate IDs are not invented human hypotheses.
perceptual_lineage.registration: For each frame, register_sample(sample.sample_id), then for each actual emitted Spark in spark_id order call register_spark(spark.spark_id,tuple(sorted(spark.parents))). Require every parent exactly resolves to that episode's registered sample and every observed concept vector has the recorded emitted Spark provenance. Empty emission still records its registered sample.
perceptual_lineage.scope: A fresh C13 EvidenceLedger registration graph per sensory episode/variant, at most9 samples and72 emitted Sparks. This graph is outside the vector-only concept bank.
perceptual_lineage.trace: Store actual perceptual_spark_ids, parent_sample_ids and canonical C13 registry state hash beside each sensory frame; do not pass them, world labels or evaluator context into bank.observe.

readout_and_execution_order.bank_freeze: Hash canonical complete bank state, AE weights and ridge coefficients. Repeated query and every intervention must leave all three hashes unchanged.
readout_and_execution_order.dev: Diagnostic-only. No checkpoint, threshold, representation, readout, world, control, grade, or hyperparameter selection follows dev observation.
readout_and_execution_order.features: At t=0..7 query a frozen bank on emitted x_t; phi=[1,onehot(winner_slot,8)] or [1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0] for no-match. Discovery mutation and AE optimization are disabled during this query.
readout_and_execution_order.fit: For each of90 banks across5runseeds use the same256 canonical base-train frame pairs per seed. Phi shape(256,9), Y shape(256,12), lambda=.1. B=solve(Phi.T@Phi + diag(0,.1,.1,.1,.1,.1,.1,.1,.1),Phi.T@Y). Float64, no iterative solver, pseudoinverse fallback, tuning or retraining during intervention.
order: pure fixture generation and integrity checks
base-train sensory pass, resetting C12 each episode
freeze every bank and slot map
dev evaluation without adaptation or selection
readout_and_execution_order.prediction: raw_prediction=phi@B; prediction=coordinatewise clip(raw_prediction,0,1). Per-step squared_error_sum=sum((prediction-target)^2); MSE=sum squared_error_sum/(12*number_of_steps). Retain unclipped and clipped predictions.

representations.cc0_assembly: Use immutable OnlineConceptFormer.observe with active stable feature IDs. Config association_threshold=.70, minimum_occurrences=3, minimum_members=2, activation_fraction=.60, maximum_concepts=8. Observe every train frame, including empty sets. Query active_concepts without observation in dev/test. Select top1 by descending active-member fraction then candidate ID. Do not change source clustering, association formula, internal counts or connected components.

learned_local_prototype.checkpoint: Epoch20 only, no dev selection or temperature/calibration. One AE checkpoint per run_seed, shared by canonical/shuffled discovery and every learned-space control.
learned_local_prototype.failure: Any nonfinite weight, gradient, reconstruction, or loss fails the entire run_seed; no fallback to another representation
learned_local_prototype.initialization: torch.manual_seed(run_seed); W entries sampled row-major uniform[-0.05,0.05] in float64; no other parameters and no later reinitialization
learned_local_prototype.loss: mean of squared reconstruction error over all 288 base train frames and all twelve coordinates, including quiet frames; no classification/transition/evaluator target
learned_local_prototype.network: Tied linear autoencoder only: z=W*x, reconstruction=W.T*z; W shape(4,12),48 trainable parameters, no nonlinearities or biases. Matching uses unit-L2 z; reconstruction uses unnormalized z.
learned_local_prototype.optimizer: torch.optim.SGD(lr=0.01,momentum=0,dampening=0,weight_decay=0,nesterov=false,maximize=false,foreach=false,differentiable=false,fused=false); one full-batch update per epoch, twenty epochs in canonical train frame order, exactly twenty steps

representations.online_prototype: Representation is the emitted twelve-vector normalized to unit L2 for matching, exemplars and prototype updates. An emitted all-zero vector has no representation.

schemas.candidate_state_types: status=active/dormant/retired. Source ID only for cc0 primary, pattern ID only for references, otherwise null. prototype is null for assembly and a normalized4/12-vector for prototype methods. first_seen/last_seen are accepted observation indices for primary, null for static references. Live and retired arrays sort by birth_ordinal. Parent IDs sort lexically; all parents are earlier births in the same bank.
schemas.cc0_source_state: Null outside cc0 primary. Otherwise exact{feature_counts,pair_counts,concepts,id_mapping}; feature_counts is an exact mapping over observed feature IDs to nonnegative integers; pair_counts is sorted list of exact{left_feature_id,right_feature_id,count}; concepts is sorted internal-ID list of exact{source_candidate_id,members,strength,observations,reuse_count,first_seen,last_seen}; id_mapping is sorted list of exact{source_candidate_id,candidate_id}. No source-state rewriting changes the original algorithm.
schemas.checkpoint_values: Only learned AE has weights: exact{W} numeric array shape(4,12), parameter_count48, optimizer_steps20,20 pre-update epoch losses. Identity/assembly representations have no checkpoint rows; exactly one learned checkpoint row per successful run_seed.
schemas.config_hash: SHA-256 of canonical {representation_spec,formation_spec,channel_map,control_spec_for_kind}; references and primary bind the registered settings, not unrecorded defaults.
schemas.conventions: Lists below are exact object key sets, not suggestions. IDs are nonempty strings or explicitly nullable; counts nonnegative integers excluding bool; numeric values finite float64 or explicitly nullable. Enum/index fields follow the frozen orders. Hashes are64 lowercase hex. Raw vectors are length12, latent vectors length4 for learned and12 for online. Candidate/reference IDs are scoped by bank identity.
schemas.engineering_gate_values: observed and required are finite scalar numbers or bool; observed may be null when unavailable. Required values are true for all gates except lineage_parent_resolution (1.0). passed is bool; null observed always fails. Counts, detailed failures and source manifest remain in their named artifact fields, not arbitrary nested gate payloads.
schemas.intervention_branch_arrays: For evaluated branches, winner_ids/raw_predictions/predictions contain exactly8 entries; winner IDs may be null for no-match. Other branches set all three arrays and all numeric fields null, with status no_comparator or not_instantiated. Baseline absent-slot is likewise null, not a repeated scientific observation.
schemas.scientific_stage_status: Exact object keys CC0,CC1,CC2,CC3; each exact{status,qualified_candidate_count,required_run_seeds,successful_run_seeds}. Scientific status is supported/not_supported/not_evaluated_implementation_failure; null counts when computation is unavailable, not invented zeros.
schemas.seen_observation_order: lexicographic observation_id; length equals accepted_observation_count<=288. Primary clock is accepted_observation_count-1 after a nonempty stream; static controls have count0 and empty registry.
schemas.sensory_trace: Exact existing C12 SensoryChannelTrace.as_dict object per each of12 channel coordinates, in feature-ID order; pin that source and reuse its schema without relaxing unknown-key validation.
schemas.sensory_work: Exact existing C12 SensoryWorkCounters.as_dict object; pin and reuse its schema. No hardware-efficiency claim.
schemas.structural_event_encoding: A split emits two consecutive child events in pivot-ID order, each candidate_id=child,parent_ids=[parent],births_consumed=1; both candidate_count_after values report the completed atomic split count. A merge emits one child event with two sorted parents and births_consumed=1. Parent retirement is implied by the structural event and retained in final state; do not also count it as inactivity deletion. Other events consume0 births except ordinary/reference birth consumes1. event_index is zero-based within each frame in operation order.
schemas.train_query_row_contract: Exactly256 rows per complete bank, ordered by world_order then canonical episode_index then t=0..7. These are frozen-bank queries on base train, not live discovery winners. Resolve input/emission vectors by sample_id from canonical train lineage for the same run_seed/representation. Use these raw rows to reconstruct readout features, frozen train usage, train-majority-world targeting and comparator selection. Never retroactively use them for CC0 recurrence qualification.
schemas.utility_aggregate: Same exact utility_summary fields except run_seed is absent; pool successful raw sums without averaging per-seed rounded rates.

scientific_claim: Unlabeled recurring assemblies and functional proto-concept candidates in fixed synthetic streams; no human semantic name, biological equivalence, organ claim, or cross-seed candidate-identity claim.

scope.concept_state_scope: One discovery bank per run_seed, representation, discovery_order; persists across train episodes only. Every dev/test query reads the frozen final bank without changing prototypes, counters, usage, status, or lineage.
scope.sensory_state_scope: Use the accepted C12 AdaptiveSensoryField with the exact sensory_config below, no goal bias or ablations and bypass=false; reset the sensory field at every episode boundary. Channels have twelve fixed coordinates; max_active remains eight. A quiet all-zero emitted vector is valid and never forces a match or birth.
scope.utility: Only next-channel MSE. No secondary prediction task, classification target, semantic labeling, hyperparameter search, or cross-seed prototype alignment.

Use the C15 protocol's inherited28 baseline protected paths plus unchanged concepts.py for29 protected paths, verified against the C14-base C16 worktree.
source_control.implementation_policy: The eight expected_new_source_and_test_paths are the exact frozen source-only allowlist. Do not change C12-C15 source, original concepts.py, v0.2 runtime, schemas, release manifests, package version or accepted scientific outputs. source_control.pin_amendment_contract: These are exact root-level JSON paths. The preregistered base has no base_commit/base_sha256 keys, source_commit=null and runner_execution_allowed=false. A separate amendment may add the two base keys, set source_commit to the audited source-only commit and set runner_execution_allowed=true; every other JSON value must equal the preregistered base. base_sha256 is the raw-byte SHA256 of the protocol blob at base_commit. No dependency-nested alternate names are accepted.

statistics.bootstrap: One random.Random(4366), consumed in comparison_order. For each of10000 draws sample5 run_seed positions with replacement, then for each sampled seed and each world in world_order sample4 episodes of that split with replacement. Include all8 steps of each sampled episode as a block and keep the primary/control pair. MSE denominator is sampled_steps*12. Sort all10000 finite effects; percentile rank=(n-1)*p, p=.025/.975, linear interpolation of floor/ceil. Counts and point effect are retained.
statistics.candidate_grades: Candidate-specific active subsets and causal effects have exact raw denominators but no cross-seed candidate bootstrap or candidate alignment. Replication uses the fixed representation/world grouping, not candidate IDs.
statistics.comparison_order: representation_order outer; matched_random then frequency_topk; dev then test; evaluation_variants order inner:48 comparisons
statistics.effect: control MSE-primary MSE, paired on run_seed,split,episode_id,variant and step. A positive effect favors primary.
statistics.nullable_policy: Empty selected subset produces null MSE/effect, never0. For any undefined bootstrap draw or point effect, retain a finite point effect if available, consume all draws without redraw/drop/imputation, and set both bounds null. Retain defined_resamples and undefined_resamples summing to10000. Missing required seed means no bootstrap execution and effect/bounds/counts all null.
statistics.reporting: Return raw sums and denominators, per-run-seed summaries, pooled summaries, effects and descriptive95% intervals. Scientific thresholds use registered point estimates; no p-values, familywise significance claim or post-hoc threshold changes.
statistics.surface_shortcut_metrics: For each representation/world report MSE and control gains separately, especially decoy_reversal; report perturbation/distractor/order effects versus base within the same seed/episode and target bytes. No semantic classification is inferred from the known generating motifs.

world_generator.context: c=(m+episode_index%2)%3 for train/dev; c=(m+2)%3 for test. Test motif/context pairings are absent from train; contexts are evaluator fields, never separate discovery inputs.
world_generator.full_hash_document: For each run_seed/split hash canonical {schema_version,run_seed,split,episodes}; include only the base nine-frame fixtures and evaluator audit. Variant values are exactly derived as above, not independently sampled.
pseudocode: For split in train,dev,test, world in world_order, episode_index ascending: create one opaque episode; for t=0..8 initialize twelve exact zeros.
Set foreground coordinates base_foreground[world][m] to 1.0 and coordinate 6+c to 0.25.
In frequency_distractor set channel9 to 1.0. In decoy_reversal set channel(9+m) to 0.75 for train/dev and channel(9+(m+1)%3) to 0.75 for test.

For each nonzero coordinate j only, replace v by clip(v+0.02*(2*U('c16|amplitude|'+str(run_seed)+'|'+split+'|'+world+'|'+str(episode_index)+'|'+str(t)+'|'+str(j))-1),0,1). Exact-zero coordinates remain zero. This seed-dependent amplitude is part of the base fixture, not a result-selected perturbation.

Keep the base nine-frame document and evaluator-only foreground/context/phase audit. Discovery receives only SensorySample values, opaque sample/source IDs and numeric time; it cannot read split, world, phase, context label, next-frame target or episode_seed.

The predictable task target at t<8 is the base, unfiltered twelve-vector at t+1. Apply evaluation sensor corruption only to current input frames, never to this common target. All four variants share target bytes and episode identity.
For amplitude_perturbation add 0.02*(2*U('c16|perturb|'+sample_id+'|'+str(j))-1) to each nonzero base coordinate and clip to [0,1]. Leave exact zeros zero.

For irrelevant_distractor choose the first coordinate j among [9,10,11] sorted by H('c16|distractor|'+sample_id+'|'+str(j)) whose base value is zero; set it to 0.2. Such a coordinate always exists. It is an observation nuisance, not a future target change.

base and order_shuffle use identical input frame values. order_shuffle selects the bank formed with train episodes sorted by H('c16|shuffle|'+str(run_seed)+'|'+episode_id), tie episode_id; never shuffle frame order.

SensorySample time=t within an episode, entity_hint=null, metadata={}, omitted_channels=(), correlation_group='cg-'+H(episode_id+'|stream')[0:24]. Send all twelve values at every frame. Build emitted x[j] from emitted Spark.activation and zero otherwise, retaining emission mask separately. Active member features require emitted AND abs(activation)>0.
world_generator.stable_feature_id: 'local_numeric:'+channel; never use frame-unique spark_id as a concept member feature
